brand.tagline: Accounting and financial management for Suriname
brand.metaDescription: Cloud accounting for Surinamese businesses and accounting firms: SRD, USD and EUR, CBvS rates, BTW and annual accounts.

status.intro: ARA Accounting is being built for the Surinamese market: double-entry bookkeeping, receivables and payables, bank and cash, fixed assets, budgets, reporting, year-end closing, BTW returns and annual accounts — in one integrated platform.
status.notYetAvailable: The application is not yet available for use. This page shows the progress.

phases.p2: Accounting core: ledger, journals, journal entries, trial balance
phases.p3: Purchases, sales, bank and cash, current accounts, fixed assets
phases.p5: Foreign currency: CBvS rates, exchange differences, revaluation
phases.p7: ARA Scan: document scanning and booking suggestions
phases.p9: Year-end closing, annual accounts and tax returns
phases.p11: Subscriptions and practice management for accounting firms

highlights.currency: SRD, USD and EUR with Centrale Bank van Suriname rates
highlights.tax: BTW (10% / 25% / 0%) and income tax as configurable, verifiable rules
highlights.law: Annual accounts under the Wet op de Jaarrekening (S.B. 2017 no. 84)
highlights.banks: Import profiles for Surinamese banks and cash books per currency

status.verification: Tax and legal settings are only marked as verified after review by a Surinamese tax advisor and accountant.
